conflict_resolutions.PARTIAL_END_CANDIDATE_ON_YES_ORDER: The candidate events are the annual continuation notices of the Iran emergency of March 15, 1995 (FR Docs. 2021-05037, 2022-04907, 2023-05300, 2024-05568, 2025-04104 and 2026-04450), which the machine tagged as revocations. I read their held texts: each lists the orders under which additional steps were taken, including Executive Order 13553, and states that Executive Order 13716 revoked Executive Orders 13574, 13590, 13622 and 13645 and provisions of Executive Order 13628, and that Executive Order 13846 revoked Executive Orders 13716 and 13628. None of those revocations names Executive Order 13553, and the notices continue the emergency on which this order relies. No partial end of this order is shown.

research_rationale:
Executive Order 13553 of 2010-09-28 (75 FR 60567, PDF pages 1-5) is held as the Federal Register original (govinfo PDF text layer, grade official original).
